quotes.text: I don't think anyone here in Congress is an artificial intelligence expert.

Under no circumstances should the Chinese Communist Party have access to government devices, and we can’t risk it gaining a foothold through DeepSeek. [...] I’m joining onto this commonsense, bipartisan bill to ban DeepSeek on devices issued by the federal government because we need to use every tool at our disposal to keep the CCP far away from our confidential and sensitive data.

What an honor it was to meet with Grammy & Oscar-winning songwriter Paul Williams with @ASCAP to discuss the impact of AI in the music industry and how Congress can best support artists. https://t.co/Y7Ki7mDGM6

Congratulations to Anik Sahai from FAU High, winner of this year’s Congressional App Challenge, for his incredible app, SunGuard.

By using AI to bring skin cancer screening right to your phone, Anik is showing what innovative young minds in Florida can do. I couldn’t be more proud to represent innovative young minds like Anik and all the talented students who submitted projects this year. Florida’s future is bright!

Just as the Space Race defined a generation, the AI race will shape the future. That's why we must do all we can to ensure advanced U.S. AI chips are not sold to China or other countries of concern.

The RESTRICT Act does just that. I'm proud to join @RepGregoryMeeks in introducing this common-sense step to protect U.S. national security and AI leadership.

Florida is home to incredible artists who continue to shape culture across the country. As AI continues to evolve, I met with @GRAMMYAdvocacy to discuss ways we can protect creators from unauthorized use of their work and likeness. Artists deserve control over their work and fair compensation; our law must ensure we don’t forget them as technology advances.
China and our adversaries are running multiple psyop operations through American platforms in order to foment division among Americans. And it has been working.
